text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis at the start","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents a controlling claim early and keeps each paragraph tied to that claim."},{"evidence":"separate body paragraphs on teachers, learning, and community","quality":"coherence","description":"Ideas are grouped into distinct sections that move the argument forward in a readable sequence."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like 'A teachers main job...' and 'Learning and understanding something new...'","quality":"development","description":"The essay builds each point with explanation rather than only repeating the main idea."},{"evidence":"more sustained argument throughout","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The writer expands claims with supporting reasoning and examples instead of relying on brief assertions."},{"evidence":"varied sentence openings and longer complex sentences","quality":"sentence variety","description":"The essay uses more varied syntactic structures, which makes the writing sound more controlled and mature."},{"evidence":"mostly understandable word choice such as 'volunteering,' 'frustrating,' and 'independent adults'","quality":"lexical control","description":"The essay shows more appropriate vocabulary choices for an academic argument."},{"evidence":"fewer sentence-level breakdowns","quality":"conventions control","description":"Although there are errors, the essay has noticeably better control of grammar, spelling, and punctuation overall."}]}
